page.label: Monday, September 14, in class
page.text: Each of you teaches one of the six kingdoms from a printed set: one card per kingdom, with its own map, and the words in red are the important facts. You fill in your own row on the chart first, then the other five rows as each owner teaches. Keep the set and the chart: they are your study sheet for the map quiz and for Quiz 1. Keep at the Spain map this week: regions, cities, waters, with the blank map and the Map Trainer on this site.

page.label: Monday, September 21
page.text: Map quiz on Spain: regions, cities, waters. The blank map is the whole plan.

page.label: Build a Guild
page.text: Three guilds formed Thursday: fishmongers, blacksmiths, and bakers. Keep your charter answers from class. Each guild will write out a full charter in its best calligraphy and bring in a masterwork of its trade. The dates will be posted here and in Educate.

glance.text: you teach one kingdom in class; keep at the Spain map.
charter and masterwork dates to come.

page.label: Due Tuesday, September 15
page.text: Read Matthew 13:54 to 16:12. Annotate 15:21 to 28 with your honest reaction to how Jesus speaks to the Canaanite woman, even if the reaction is that it bothers you. Write one discussion question on 15:21 to 28, on paper, for the door Tuesday. No class Monday.

glance.text: Matthew 13:54 to 16:12; annotate 15:21 to 28 honestly; one written discussion question.

page.label: Monday, September 14 (study day)
page.text: No new reading. Bring your annotated Inferno. The color study guide comes home today: every row is colored by place in Hell, and the second sheet carries what the commentators say about the two paragraph themes. After the Mass pause we review all thirteen cantos together: each of you walks the class through one piece of Hell on the Map of Hell, then the Inferno Drill on the projector. What the room misses goes on the board and becomes the study list for Monday night.

page.label: Tuesday, September 15
page.text: Quiz on Cantos I to XIII, closed book, at the start of the period, about twenty minutes: for every circle the place, the sin, and the contrapasso (the canto number or the place will do), and two written paragraphs on what we argued in class. Then we start Cantos XIV and XV. Review with your annotations, the study guide, the Map of Hell, and the Inferno Drill (Quiz 1 set).

page.label: Thursday, September 17
page.text: Bring a Dante-themed poem to present, about three minutes: sin, desire, freedom, courage, mentorship, or love of place. Start looking this weekend.

page.label: Super Simile
page.text: Paragraphs 1 and 2 (the Charon birds, the Harpies) are in your folder. The folder stays in the room.

glance.text: study day; no new reading; bring your book; study guide comes home.
quiz on Cantos I to XIII at the start of class, two paragraphs included.
bring a Dante-themed poem to present.
Rehearsals Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday, last period; the Friday sing at 1:23. The first all-school Friday sing was September 11.
